name: exec
args:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
files = sorted(pathlib.Path('data/orders').glob('*.json'))
before = {p: p.read_bytes() for p in files}
for p, raw in before.items():
    order = json.loads(raw)
    if order['status'] != 'paid':
        continue
    assert 'itemCount' not in order, p
    assert raw.endswith(b'\n}\n'), p
    count = sum(item['qty'] for item in order['items'])
    p.write_bytes(raw[:-3] + b',\n  "itemCount": ' + str(count).encode() + b'\n}\n')
for p, raw in before.items():
    original = json.loads(raw)
    result_raw = p.read_bytes()
    result = json.loads(result_raw)
    if original['status'] == 'paid':
        count = sum(item['qty'] for item in original['items'])
        assert result == dict(original, itemCount=count), p
        assert result_raw == (json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode(), p
    else:
        assert result_raw == raw, p
print(f"Verified {sum(json.loads(raw)['status'] == 'paid' for raw in before.values())} paid orders; {sum(json.loads(raw)['status'] != 'paid' for raw in before.values())} other orders unchanged.")
PY","max_output_tokens":2000}); text(r.output);
